facts.fact: The Prime Minister inaugurated the Somalia Computer Incident Response Team (SOMCIRT) on 7 March 2026, created under the January 2026 Cybersecurity Law to coordinate prevention, detection and response to incidents nationally.

slug: 2026-01-29 Somali Parliament approves Cybersecurity Law amid rising threats

facts.fact: The Cybersecurity Law approved by the House of the People on 26 January 2026 provides for the creation of the Somalia Computer Incident Response Team (SOM-CIRT), a nine-member cybersecurity committee and an emergency intervention centre.
The National Communications Authority states the Cybersecurity Law approved by the House of the People on 26 January 2026 establishes the Somalia Computer Incident Response Team (SOM-CIRT).
